environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate, connecting directly to PostgreSQL 15 on RDS. Port 5432 exposed to the service via security group. No query middleware or connection pooler between the application and database. Environment variables: DB_HOST=rds-instance.cluster-xyz.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com, DB_PORT=5432. Application runs with db_owner role permissions.

config.network: VPC security group allows 5432 from service subnet
